verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama has a REST API (ollama-gh-4), OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints (ollama-docs-12, ollama-docs-13), and Python/JS libraries (ollama-docs-19). However, no item mentions streaming responses, incremental token delivery, or a stream parameter. Token streaming is a fair axis for a model-serving API, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.
